text:
maria: Quick sync — need to lock Hybrid Credit Floor packaging for pilot. Summary: customer wants predictable burst for embeddings-heavy workloads; they asked for a soft floor of 500k tokens/month + surge credits. We need decision: soft floor (credits roll over) vs slab (minimum commit). Can we draft a simple SKU and launch criteria by EOW?

jason: can we do soft floor + overage smoothing? would prefer avoiding legal on min commits :thinking_face:

leo: runtime note: we can limit per-endpoint throughput and enforce pool isolation, but aggregating across models for a 'single pool' floor requires billing joiner instrumentation.

camille: propose 'Hybrid Starter' SKU: 100k base tokens/month, 5k surge credits auto-apply, rollover up to 2x base. Draft config below:

```json
{
  "sku": "hybrid-starter",
  "base_tokens": 100000,
  "surge_credits": 5000,
  "rollover_cap_multiplier": 2,
  "burst_window": "30d"
}
```

maria: looks reasonable. Rollout checklist: 1) Latency SLO per route, 2) Cost delta <10% vs on-demand, 3) Customer acceptance tests (via eval sets), 4) Billing instrumentation for rollover accounting. If all green, GA pilot.

deploy-bot: RFC created: /rfc/packaging/hybrid-credit-floor-5480012345 :page_with_curl:

jason: +1 to tests. Legal flagged: need optional enterprise carve-out clause for strict commits. cc @carmen-sales

camille: I'll prototype pricing calc + customer-sim tomorrow and share numbers in the doc. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

leo: runtime FYI: KV cache hit rate and batching behavior will change token accounting; include guidance that customers using heavy caching see lower billing tokens—we should document expected variance.

maria: Action items: camille (pricing sim), jason (legal language), leo (perf sim), i'll add to roadmap board and schedule sync Tue 11am. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
